description: The website details the visual script (sdk/visual) reads about a visitor: one entry per web_ key it sends, with the data-collect value that turns it on, whether a tag without data-collect collects it, its name and its values as the dashboard and the docs show them, and the install guide's table cells. The keys and the closed values equal the server's (backend/tests/unit/schemas/test_visual_visitor_attributes.py) and the script's (sdk/visual/__tests__/details.test.ts); docs/sdk/visual.md's table is these rows. A detail the script cannot read in its form is not sent.

details.label: Device type
details.source: The browser's user agent, whether it says it is a mobile, and its touch points

details.label: Language
details.source: The browser's language, its first part (en for en-US)

details.label: New or returning
details.source: Whether this browser was first seen before this visit started

details.label: Came from
details.source: The host of the page that linked to this one, when it is another host

details.label: Campaign source
details.source: utm_source in the address of the visit's first page
details.sent: Yes, on every page of the visit

details.label: Campaign medium
details.source: utm_medium in the address of the visit's first page
details.sent: Yes, on every page of the visit

details.label: Campaign name
details.source: utm_campaign in the address of the visit's first page
details.sent: Yes, on every page of the visit

details.label: Landing page
details.source: The path of the visit's first page, without its query
details.sent: Only with landing in data-collect, on every page of the visit
